main_result: The same normalized interaction with an explicit finite dynamic reference gives the complete isolated low band, partner-preserving encoding, actual fixed-parameter drive sources and backreaction, and separated held-out response intervals after one calibration.
scope_limits: The reference free kernel, drive, Dirac momentum dictionary and finite control/readout permissions are declared inputs, not newly adopted cognitive axioms.
Old resonant handoff and driven low-band experiments are different settings of the same parameterized parent family.
The finite occupation cutoff is an exact declared model; no infinite-cutoff limit is certified.
All ordered low levels and the full reference gap are controlled; product preparation and canonical dressed encoding have separate permissions and error bounds.
The true source includes the encoding connection; reference baseline, interaction energy and measurement work remain in the complete ledger.
Effective drive exchange is accounted for, but an autonomous quantum controller is not constructed.
The linear comparison deletes the balance contract and only matches the first-order block at the calibration point.
The finite drive source and Dirac energy block do not identify a local Higgs field, physical mass pole or complete standard-model realization.
Stage-wide parameter embeddings and all original completion criteria still require the joint paper and independent acceptance.
